user.title: Door Entry account
user.description: Sign in with the account of the BTicino Door Entry app. The cloud is only used once, to get the gateway password and a SIP certificate; everything then runs locally.

data_description.remember_password: Stored in Home Assistant to renew the certificate (valid about 2 years) and the gateway password automatically. Otherwise you will be asked to sign in again before it expires.

host.title: Gateway address
host.description: Local IP address of the Classe 300X (gateway {gateway_id}). Give it a fixed DHCP lease.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Password of the Door Entry account {email}. A new certificate will be requested.

data_description.remember_password: Stored in Home Assistant to renew the certificate (valid about 2 years) and the gateway password automatically. Otherwise you will be asked to sign in again before it expires.

error.invalid_open_password: The gateway refused the OpenWebNet password.
error.cannot_connect_local: Cannot reach the gateway on port 20000.
error.cannot_connect_sip: The gateway refused the SIP connection (port 5061).

abort.cloud_error: The BTicino cloud did not return the gateway credentials.

data_description.devaddr: Address of the door station to call for video and audio (20 for a single door station).
data_description.locks: Comma-separated; one button per lock (20 = lock of the main door station).
data_description.stair_light: Leave empty if you have none.
data_description.talk_gain: Amplification of the messages played on the door station speaker.

error.invalid_address: Addresses are numbers, for example 20 or 21.

certificate_expired.message: The SIP certificate has expired, sign in again.

invalid_open_password.message: The gateway refused the OpenWebNet password.

command_failed.message: The gateway did not accept the command: {error}

busy.message: The door station is busy (someone is ringing or it is already in use).

no_video.message: No image received from the door station.

no_speex.message: libspeex is not installed on this system, the speaker cannot work.

renewal_failed.message: The SIP certificate has expired and the BTicino cloud cannot be reached to renew it; retrying later.

confirm.title: Renew the SIP certificate
confirm.description:
The certificate used by Home Assistant to talk to the gateway expires on {date}. After that, the door, camera and speaker will stop working.

Confirm to sign in to your Door Entry account again: a new certificate will be requested. Tick "Remember the password" to have it renewed automatically next time.
